sample_mapping_evidence: 21 source blood observations/nine people: three healthy controls, three inhalation-injury and three traumatic-injury patients at acute/progressive/convalescent visits. Explicit M/N hash calls map two fractions to one source specimen; Negative, Doublet and missing calls never receive a donor.

PCA and tSNE analysis was used for the single cell to cell relation description. The fastMNN function  (k = 5, d = 50, approximate = TRUE, auto.order = TRUE) from R package scran (v1.10.2) was used to apply mutual nearest neighbor method to correct for batch effect among samples. extract_protocol_ch1: Cells from each sample were used for single-cell isolation using BD Rhapsody Single-Cell Analysis System (BD Biosciences). Before single-cell isolation, all cells were labeled and annotated by sample tag using a BD Single-Cell Multiplexing Kit. Finally, multiple samples were mixed together.
Sequencing libraries were conducted using the BD Rhapsody Single-Cell Analysis System (BD Biosciences), following the manufacture's protocol.
data_processing: Basecalls performed using CASAVA version 1.8
Cellranger was utilized to calculate the raw counts and cell whitelist by default parameter
1. We applied the Seurat [https://satijalab.org/seurat/] package for cell normalization and cell filtering considering the MT percentage, minimum and maximum gene numbers under following criteria:
 Cell Gene Number < 10000;
 Cell Gene Number > 200.

PCA and tSNE analysis was used for the single cell to cell relation description. The fastMNN function  (k = 5, d = 50, approximate = TRUE, auto.order = TRUE) from R package scran (v1.10.2) was used to apply mutual nearest neighbor method to correct for batch effect among samples.  Graphcluster was utilized for cell clustering and based on the marker gene achieved some cluster was combined. Wilcox rank sum test was then used for marker gene analysis.
Supplementary files format and content: GRCh38Ensembl100
Supplementary files format and content: MTX file and TSV file contain counts for each barcodes and genes
